purpose: Select one immutable standardized-residual support for a proper bounded V50 conditional likelihood using all and only the frozen train voxels, before model implementation, fitting, validation diagnostics, development sampling, or gate access.

parent_evidence.required_family: proper train-only bounded-support monotone conditional transform likelihood

population.standardized_residual: z=(truth-backbone-target_mean)/target_std using the immutable V45 conditioning cache

support_rule.global_minimum: minimum z over every frozen train voxel in all three domains
support_rule.global_maximum: maximum z over every frozen train voxel in all three domains
support_rule.boundary: open interval; every train value must be strictly interior
support_rule.rounding: store IEEE-754 float64 results without manual rounding

hard_checks: clean committed worktree and exact V49 record, V48 program, and cache hashes
all expected train object and voxel counts match
all standardized residuals and extrema are finite
every train voxel lies strictly inside the selected open support
no validation or development data are opened
no Astrid or historical EAGLE data are accessed
